title: Stone structures

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Stone structures become available after the acquisition of iron and subsequently a stonecutter. They require stone and the proximity of a stonecutter to be built and repaired.
Stone fortifications are stronger than those from wood, which can make them more resistant against raids.

sections.heading: Common properties
sections.text: Stone structures share the following properties:

table_data.Value: Weak: Pickaxe Neutral: Blunt, Slash, Pierce, Chop, Lightning Resistant: Fire, Frost Immune: Poison, Spirit
